title: For My Girls | KEY.co
description_expanded: As you step inside, a sense of comfort and sophistication envelops you. The double living area welcomes you with its inviting fireplace, ensuring everyone finds a cozy spot to relax. The spacious kitchen, adorned with beautiful Viking appliances and a separate bar, sets the stage for culinary adventures. Whether you're preparing a hearty breakfast, enjoying afternoon snacks and drinks, or organizing an elegant dinner with the freshest Florida produce, this kitchen is a haven for food enthusiasts and aspiring mixologists. Additionally, the second floor features two queen bedrooms, each with its unique features. The third bedroom offers a private bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, ample storage, and a private TV. The fourth bedroom features a queen bed, a work desk perfect for remote work, a private bathroom with a shower, and a furnished porch for moments of relaxation. The media room and wet bar on this level provide a cozy space to unwind, whether watching a movie as a family or enjoying a nightcap or two.
